gric.title: GRIC token access
gric.description:
For a shared car or a non-owner account, which the SMS channel's gateway refuses.
Paste the refreshToken from the Zeekr app; the integration renews it automatically and never needs the phone again.
Note: only the last holder of a session stays valid, so the app has to log in again after a rotation.
{detail}

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description:
The stored credentials for {phone} have expired. Request a new verification code to continue.
{detail}
